description:
We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a compassionate team focused on patient recovery and well-being, providing essential therapy services to residents.

As a COTA, you will work under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist, implementing individualized treatment plans to help patients regain independence and improve their quality of life. We offer a competitive hourly rate for this full-time position, reflecting your valuable skills and commitment to patient care.
requirements: Current COTA licensure in the state of Florida
Associate's degree from an accredited Occupational Therapy Assistant program
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00 based on experience.
